## 🎯 Problem statement
A clear and concise description of **what problem** this feature solves.
> *"As a [role], I want to [action] so that [benefit]."*

## 💡 Proposed solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🧩 Alternatives considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 🌍 Use case
How would this feature be used in a corporate onboarding / L&D scenario?

## 📝 Additional context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

---
**Checklist**
- [ ] I searched for existing issues (including closed ones)
- [ ] I described the problem, not just the solution
- [ ] I included a concrete use case
